scope: All future JNU / Osaka Nikkei 225 Micro research, backtesting, pre-market, intraday, post-market and framework-development tasks.
principle: Use the best available no-extra-cost tool/skill/plugin when it materially improves freshness, accuracy or completeness. Do not default to prose-only analysis when a suitable tool is available.

priorities.storage: GitHub Actions .cache/market-data for reusable cloud cache; requests/manifests/source hashes/results/reports durable in the private repo
priorities.rule: Cloud-first. Do not make D:\QROS or other local files the authoritative backtest source when the cloud workflow exists.
priorities.note: GitHub Actions cache is reusable but evictable; durable raw object storage is not yet enabled.

priorities.category: Live/current JNU chart and market-state analysis
priorities.primary: TradingView Unified MCP / TradingView Nikkei analysis layer
priorities.rule: Use TradingView tooling when live chart/session context is needed. If unavailable, explicitly mark the gap and use user screenshots or other verified sources rather than inventing values.

priorities.category: Current public market and official data
priorities.primary: Official JPX/OSE, Nikkei Indexes, CME, SGX and other first-party sources via web/tools
priorities.secondary: Jerry Market Research connector where already configured and no extra paid service is introduced
priorities.rule: For current contract specs, trading hours, official index/futures daily data and exchange notices, prefer official sources.

primary: Elicit or other available academic research plugins/skills
priorities.rule: Before adding a JNU factor/module, search validated academic/empirical evidence first. Prefer direct Nikkei/Japanese-market evidence; then broader market microstructure evidence.

priorities.primary: Public web feeds such as Yahoo chart data only when needed for pilot/sanity checks
priorities.storage_class: CACHE_ONLY unless source-specific durable storage is approved
priorities.rule: Never promote a proxy-only pilot to VALIDATED_JNU_MODULE. DPD formal validation requires venue-specific OSE/SGX/CME contract identity and approved data provenance.

priorities.primary: Remote Desktop Commander / local QROS inspection
priorities.rule: Use only for environment inspection, migration, diagnostics, or capabilities unavailable in the cloud. Do not silently substitute local-only data/results for the cloud research record.

framework_rules: Use the JNU evidence-first architecture and current validated/conditional/research-only/rejected module statuses.
Dynamic Price Discovery, volatility/tail risk, news sentiment and other new modules remain research candidates until they pass preregistered OOS gates.
Do not resurrect rejected fixed cross-market majority-vote logic.
Do not widen parameters or lag windows after seeing results without registering a new experiment/trial.
Include costs/slippage and multiple-testing/overfit controls before promotion.
For news/current-event analysis, use fresh web or news tools; for fast-changing facts, do not rely on memory.

cost_policy.allowed: Already-connected or already-paid user services may be used only if they do not create a new charge and materially help.
cost_policy.forbidden: Do not enable paid runners, paid data subscriptions, or paid infrastructure without explicit user approval.

persistence_rule: This file is the authoritative cross-session JNU tooling policy. Future JNU work should consult it before choosing tools.
